title: End User License Agreement
intro: Welcome to our platform. Please read this End User License Agreement carefully before using our services.
locationText: Our platform uses location services to share directions with tourists. We only capture stationary coordinates during experience creation and do not track your movement continuously.
translationText: We use machine translation to help guides present their content to more travelers. Please note that translations may not always be perfect.
privacyText: Do not share sensitive information such as passwords, personal identification numbers, or payment details anywhere.
dataSharingText: Your personal and booking data are not shared with third parties outside the platform. Only authorized providers will see relevant booking information.
